title: Thread-Safe Lazy App Registry & Topological Initialization in Multi-Tenant / Plugin Architectures

claims.assertion: Plugin and application registries in large ecosystems must decouple discovery from population via reentrant threading locks, explicit state phases (ready, models_ready, apps_ready), and lazy model lookup index caching

context: In modular architectures and extensible agent harnesses with dozens of independent plugins and services, naive eager initialization causes circular import deadlocks, race conditions during multi-threaded startup, and uncoordinated model registration.
distilled_learning: Implement an Apps/Plugin registry that operates in three distinct topological lifecycle phases: 1) Instantiation & Discovery, 2) Model/Service Registration (setting models_ready=True under threading.RLock), and 3) Post-Ready hook invocation (setting ready=True). Use a two-tiered dictionary cache (app_configs by label, models by (app_label, model_name)) with lazy resolution proxies so plugins can reference foreign dependencies before all sub-modules are fully imported.
